title.narrative: CONSTRUCTION OF THE BISHKEK- OSH ROAD

description.narrative: THE PROJECT AIMS TO CONSTRUCT TWO NEW SECTIONS OF THE BISHKE K_OSH ROAD AT MADANIAT DETOUR (9 KM LENGTH) AND JALALABAD _ UZGEN (40 KM LENGTH) IN ORDER TO BYPASS UZBEK TERRITORY AND TO PROVIDE THIS ROAD WITH 100 KM/HR DESIGN SPEED.
